capabilities: Annotate Markdown and PDF files with pen, pencil, highlighter, and eraser tools
Organize ink, text, shapes, and whiteboards in editable layers
Select, transform, copy, and paste annotations with lasso tools
Generate derived images from PDF pages with color selection and geometric correction
Export merged annotated PDFs or ZIP packages with full layer data
extras: All features are free; sponsorship is voluntary and unlocks nothing. Annotations are stored as JSON in a .hand-note-layers vault folder. Much of the README is a parallel Chinese-language document; beta installation requires the BRAT plugin.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to handwrite or draw on Markdown notes and PDFs without modifying the source files.
summary: Layer-based handwriting and drawing annotation plugin for Markdown and PDF files, with Apple Pencil input and non-destructive storage.
